# Clientory - AI Visibility for Immigration Law Firms
# https://clientory.org

> Clientory is an AI visibility and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
> monitoring platform built for independent immigration law firms, from solo
> attorneys through mid-sized practices.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://clientory.org
- About: https://clientory.org/about
- GEO Guide: https://clientory.org/geo-for-professional-services
- Pricing: https://clientory.org/pricing
- Blog: https://clientory.org/blog
- Clientory App: https://app.clientory.org

## What We Do
Clientory tracks how often and how accurately AI platforms mention and recommend
immigration law firms. Scans run today against ChatGPT and Claude on the free
report, plus Gemini on subscribed scans; Perplexity, Copilot, and other AI
search engines are on the roadmap.
The product has three parts:

1. AI Visibility Scanner — generates 5 prompts for the free report or 25 for a
   subscribed scan from a company's name, location, practice areas, and website.
   The free report returns a 0-100 visibility score and per-prompt results graded
   Positive / Passive / No mention. Subscribed scans add Gemini, competitor-gap
   analysis, and automatic weekly re-scanning.
2. AI Presence Coach — a chat coach personalized to the firm's latest scan,
   covering score, competitor gaps, and specific recommendations. Paid only.
3. AI Citation Monitor — weekly snapshots tracking score over time, alerts when
   a new competitor enters the firm's prompts, and configurable email alerts on
   score changes. Included with the one-month trial and paid subscription only.

## Pricing
- First report: free, 5 prompts on ChatGPT and Claude, no credit card or commitment.
- Optional subscription trial: one month free with full access.
- Subscription after the trial: $10 per month.
